description: This file defines classes, structs, and interfaces related to unit conversion management, including units, categories, conversion data, and callback interfaces. It declares the main class 'UnitConverter' implementing the 'IUnitConverter' interface, along with associated data structures and external dependencies.

classes.name: Unit
classes.description: Represents a measurement unit with properties such as id, name, abbreviation, and flags indicating conversion roles and whimsical status.

classes.name: Category
classes.description: Represents a category of units, with an id, name, and support for negative values.

classes.name: UnitHash
classes.description: Hash functor for Unit objects, based on unit id.

classes.name: SuggestedValueIntermediate
classes.description: Intermediate structure for suggested conversion values, including magnitude, value, and unit type.

classes.name: ConversionData
classes.description: Holds conversion ratio, offset, and offset application order for unit conversions.

classes.name: CurrencyStaticData
classes.description: Contains static information about a currency, including country and currency codes, names, and symbols.

classes.name: CurrencyRatio
classes.description: Represents a currency conversion ratio between source and target currency codes.

classes.name: IViewModelCurrencyCallback
classes.description: Interface for callbacks related to currency data loading and updates.

classes.name: IConverterDataLoader
classes.description: Interface for loading conversion data, categories, units, and ratios.

classes.name: ICurrencyConverterDataLoader
classes.description: Interface for loading currency-specific data and ratios, with callback setting and async data loading methods.

classes.name: IUnitConverterVMCallback
classes.description: Interface for UI callbacks related to unit conversion display and suggested values.

classes.name: IUnitConverter
classes.description: Interface defining the unit conversion management operations.

classes.name: UnitConverter
classes.description: Main class implementing unit conversion logic, managing categories, units, ratios, and callbacks.
